title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Guy. Part 9
body: He says his ex was crazy, his boss was crazy, his landlord was crazy and his best friend was crazy. Four crazy people and one reasonable man. Do the math. He also says "I'm too honest" every time he says something rude. Honest is not the same as unkind with a microphone.
caption:
Tag the friend who says he is different.

title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Girl. Part 9
body: She says she wants honesty. Then she asks "do I look fat" and "is she prettier than me." There is no correct answer, only a judge who has already decided. If you say yes, you are rude. If you say no, you are lying. If you say nothing, you are the problem.
caption:
Send this to him. Anonymously.

title: 🚩 Red Flags in a Rishta Meeting. Part 9
body: Your father asks about his salary with a straight face. His father asks about your "expectations" politely. Both families say "we want nothing." Both mean different things. The word nothing is doing a lot of work in this room, and everyone is pretending to be fine.
caption:
Tag the friend who survived this exact meeting.

title: 🚩 The Maybe Zone. Part 9
body: When she finally replies she says "sorry, just saw this." Seen eleven days ago. You say "no problem." You are the only person in the world who says no problem to a delay of eleven days. Your self respect is typing. It has been typing for months.
caption:
Tag the one who is stuck in the maybe zone.

title: 🚩 Red Flags on a First Date. Part 9
body: He says "you're not like other girls." Which girls? How many? He says "I don't usually do this" and the waiter says "welcome back sir." The cafe has his usual table. The staff know his usual order. And his usual line, which you were just given.
caption:
Send this before your next date.

title: 🚩 Red Flags When He Texts. Part 9
body: He uses a laughing emoji when you are sad and a thumbs up for "I love you." A thumbs up on your paragraph is not a feeling, it is a legal acknowledgement. He replies fast to his friends and slow to you. Compare the speed. That is the ranking.
caption:
Tag the friend who is waiting for a reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Her Emotional Support Contact. Part 9
body: Test: tell her you are busy this weekend. If she disappears, you were a service. If she asks what is wrong, she is a friend. Friends check on you when it is not their emergency. Everyone else is a customer who just found out the shop has closing hours.
caption:
Send this to someone who always listens and never gets asked.

title: 🚩 How to Never Date a Playboy. Part 9
body: All twelve exes are crazy. One crazy ex is bad luck. Twelve is a pattern. He keeps in touch with all of them "just as friends," and they all like his photos. It is not a friend list, it is a waiting room. You have a number and a ticket.
caption:
Send this to the friend who says he's changed.

title: 🚩 Red Flags in His Instagram. Part 9
body: He has fourteen thousand followers and gets forty likes. He says "the algorithm is against me." The algorithm is not against him. His followers are from a country he has never visited, and he paid for them in 2021 with his Eid money.
caption:
Send this to a friend who is stalking his profile.

title: 🚩 The Taxi Light Theory. Part 9
body: How to survive it. Do not check his profile. Do not compare yourself to her. Do not ask her friends. Go outside, take a breath, eat the biryani. There will be another taxi. It will probably be on duty. And the driver will not need a speech to stop.
caption:
Send this to someone who thinks it was their fault.

title: 🚩 Who Has to Approve Your Marriage. Part 9
body: The twist: the committee cares until you turn thirty. Then they ask "why aren't you married?" Same people who rejected the last eleven proposals. They want results without deliverables. The deadline moves and the standards stay. Smile, and pass the raita.
caption:
Send this to the family group chat. We dare you.

title: 🚩 How to Find a Spiritual Partner. Part 9
body: He has a crystal for love, a crystal for money and a crystal for anxiety. The anxiety is still there. He has no crystal for apologising. He has bought nine. He keeps one near the door to "protect the energy" and still comes home to a messy life. Nothing works without effort.
caption:
Send this to someone who is healing at your expense.

title: 🚩 How to Read a Rishta Profile. Part 9
body: "Same biradari preferred" sits right next to "we believe in equality." The form has six filters and no hobbies. Love is blind, but the biodata has fourteen conditions and a vision test. Somewhere in there is a person who likes mangoes and old Bollywood songs.
caption:
Tag the friend whose biodata needs a rewrite.
